$comment: U-075. The escorted character (a rescued prisoner): unarmed, never fights. He does what the squad last told him — `stay` (hold where he stands), `go` (to the ordered point, then stay there) — and otherwise follows the squad's lead at a pace the squad can match, stopping short of the lead. The orders are the session's `escortOrder`: hold, move and regroup from a player address him as stay, go and follow.
